section-51-1.TO: by order provide for a qualification specified in the order to be a relevant qualification for the purposes of section 50(2) and (3) in relation to an office or other position specified in the order

section-51-3.TO: include provision as to when a person who holds the qualification is, for the purposes of section 50, to be taken first to have held it
section-51-3.IN RELATION TO: a qualification specified in the order

section-51-8.TO: by order make provision supplementing or amending subsections (5) to (7)

section-51-9.TO: consult— (a) the Lord Chief Justice of England and Wales, and (b) the Judicial Appointments Commission
section-51-9.BEFORE: making an order under subsection (1) or (8)

section-51-10.FOR: The Lord Chief Justice of England and Wales
section-51-10.TO: nominate a judicial office holder (as defined in section 109(4) of the Constitutional Reform Act 2005 (c. 4)) to exercise his function under subsection (9)(a)

section-51-13.TO: make different provision for different purposes

section-51-14.UNLESS: a draft of the statutory instrument containing it (whether alone or with other provision) has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament
